testcase.system-out: Scenario: Select an available command without changing the custom panel ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Ribbon customization dialog shows an empty Part Tools custom panel ✔ And the source category is All Commands ✔ When the user selects "2D Sketches" in the available commands list ✔ Then the "2D Sketches" row is highlighted ✔ And the right transfer button is enabled ✔ And the custom panel list remains empty ✔ And Apply and cancels remain disabled ✔ When the user clicks Close ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And the Tools ribbon remains visible
